title: Annual Surveys, Locations & Monthly Reporting | PSC | NHSN | CDC
content: Annual Surveys, Locations & Monthly Reporting Plans Print Updated April 8, 2026 Minus Related Pages On This Page Annual Facility Surveys Locations Monthly Reporting Plan Annual Facility Surveys At the beginning of each survey year, a new facility survey(s) must be completed to reflect data from the prior calendar year. For example, at the beginning of 2026, an acute care hospital completes a 2025 Annual Hospital Survey containing data from 2025. Deadline: March 1 st After March 1 st , facilities will not be able to enter new monthly reporting plans until completion of the applicable survey(s).
